MASTER IS SQUARE, which media-with-text requires: the row height is max(text column, image natural height) and .media-with-text__media carries no aspect-ratio of its own, so a non-square master stretches its row and the block stops matching its five siblings. Measured as a set beforehand, this block renders 0.969 at 1440 and 0.682 at 1024, inside a sibling range of 0.819-1.000 and 0.599-0.890 — so the row geometry is set by the block's own text and is unchanged by this swap.

Converted to JPEG q95 4:4:4 progressive with metadata dropped (1147K), which is the documented policy in .claude/rules/website-imagery.md rule 5 — quality 95 and 4:4:4 so the CDN's WebP pass gets a clean picture to encode from, rather than a low-quality JPEG whose artefacts cost bits to reproduce. Not re-encoded below that: compressing the source was measured on 2026-08-24 and made the site marginally slower. The long edge is 2048, inside the 3000px cap and above the 2000w top of this block's srcset. Delivered bytes verified off the CDN after upload, because the CDN is what a visitor downloads.
